messages.subject: "block" operation failed
parts:
Dear all

I tried to use block operation to extract the sub-matrix, but it failed. What is the cause of the error?

I installed R by Homebrew, and RStan by https://code.google.com/p/stan/wiki/RStanGettingStarted on Mac OS X (10.8.4).

Here is a example.


Stan code
-------------
data
{
int N;
vector[N] x;
}
parameters
{
vector[N] mu;
cov_matrix[N] S;
}
transformed parameters
{
matrix[N-1,N-1] T;

T <- block(S, 1, 1, N-1, N-1);
}
model
{
x ~ multi_normal(mu, S);
}


R code
---------
> test.data <- list(N=5, x=rnorm(5))
> test.inits <- list(mu = rnorm(5), S = diag(5))
